capabilities: Export marked notes and local attachments to a configured local blog project
Convert wikilinks, aliases, embeds, and Obsidian syntax to blog-friendly Markdown
Preview publish plans with warnings and conflicts before writing files
Filter published YAML fields with a configurable allowlist
Update or withdraw previously published posts with transactional rollback
disambiguation: Not a live blog publisher; it only writes Markdown files to a local folder and never runs builds, Git, or deployment.
extras: Desktop-only (needs Node.js file-system access); writes outside the vault so withdrawn files bypass Obsidian's trash; requires a local blog project that accepts Markdown with YAML frontmatter; offline with no telemetry, Git, or deployment integration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes with converted wikilinks, embeds, and attachments as clean Markdown into a folder outside the vault for an external blog.
summary: Publishing tool that exports selected notes and their local attachments as standard Markdown with YAML frontmatter to a configurable local blog project folder.
